title: Rocket Lab
description: Build a blocky rocket from tanks, engines, fins and stages, then fly it with real rocket science: thrust vs. weight, drag, staging and gravity turns. Climb above the clouds, cross the edge of space, reach orbit and land on the Moon, and race friends to space online.
controls: Click parts to build, Space to launch and drop stages, A / D or Left / Right to tilt, R back to the lab, drag to look
